newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Cricket-South Australia win toss, bat v Western Australia.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Cricket-South Australia win toss, bat v Western Australia.

text.p: South Australia captain Jamie Siddons won the toss and chose to bat at the start of the four-day Sheffield Shield match against Western Australia at the WACA ground on Friday.
Western Australia started the match without pace bowler Jo Angel, who failed a fitness test earlier on Friday.
South Australia chose leg-spinner Peter McIntyre in favour of left-arm bowler Brad Young.
South Australia - Jamie Siddons (captain), Greg Blewett, Martin Faull, Darren Lehmann, James Brayshaw, Geoff Parker, Tim Nielsen, Jason Gillespie, Shane George, Peter McIntyre, Mark Harrity.
Western Australia - Mark Lavender, Michael Hussey, Justin Langer, Damien Martyn, Tom Moody (captain), Adam Gilchrist, Ryan Campbell, Brad Hogg, Brendon Julian, Matthew Garnaut, Matthew Nicholson.
